name: Oando PLC
source: CRON 20261122: H1 2026 column from Oando PLC unaudited interim consolidated statement of profit or loss, six months ended 30 June 2026, unit N thousands stored in absolute naira. Revenue 2,063,509,425 thousand less cost of sales 1,962,320,414 thousand equals the printed gross profit of 101,189,011 thousand. Operating expenses 77,787,454 thousand is the printed administrative expense line; the printed operating profit of 127,840,633 thousand also includes other operating income of 48,519,135 thousand and a net reversal of impairment of financial assets of 55,919,941 thousand, so gross profit less this expense cell does not reach it alone. Net finance costs 161,301,812 thousand and the printed loss before income tax of 32,839,668 thousand are as reported; the tax credit of 101,395,804 thousand, a reversal of company income tax provisions for FY2023 to FY2025 and stored negative, brings the printed profit after tax to 68,556,136 thousand. EPS is the printed basic earnings per share of 8 naira. Source: https://doclib.ngxgroup.com/Financial_NewsDocs/47734_OANDO_PLC-_QUARTER_2_-_FINANCIAL_STATEMENT_FOR_2026_FINANCIAL_STATEMENTS_JULY_2026.pdf || Yahoo Finance
